profile_rule: KP: split last two wall cells into two each, first four and last four arc cells into two each, and every flat roof cell into two. Mirror LH/RH. KT: preserve H4 profile and increase thickness layers 6 to 8. Both preserve H4 Y16; no hanging nodes.
unchanged: FULL only, t175, 3x3m including separate floor, R.40, bay1.50, NC320 trial, F-R limit, bonded crown, free Y, SW and roof LL50kgf/m2, no prestress in trial. No material or thickness selection.
interpretation: Two one-direction comparisons, not an all-axis convergence sequence. H4 is a control, not a claim to supersede IBY base/edge refinement. Combined KP+KT and IBY transfer remain uncomputed.
resource_policy: Run sequentially in local isolated runtime; retain complete raw evidence. No external compute or deployment.
